column1: The matter in dispute between the aforesaid parties is .–
‘‘Whether  R. Menikgama Arachchi and M. K. D. Manoj Gunaruwan working in the Water Supply and Drainage Board have been caused
injustice by the promotion given to them with effect from 21. 05. 2015 to the post of Manager (Human Resources) being cancelled with
effect from 07.09.2016 and if so, to what relief these two employees are entitled.’’
Dated at the office of the Commissioner General of Labour.
